This is an SCD2 customer dimension. raw_customers holds 30 customers with two versions each: a current row (is_current=True) and a historical row (is_current=False). The join in gold_region_daily fans out, so those customers' transactions are counted twice. That explains 5415 vs 4699, an excess of 716.

The correct fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. Doing so leaves 200 rows with a unique key. Every customer has exactly one current row (is_current=True: 200, distinct customers: 200).

A point-in-time join might look more precise, since the historical row's valid_from is 2023-06-01 and the current row's is 2025-01-01. But all transactions are from January 2026, after both valid_from dates, so the current row applies to every transaction. Filtering on is_current is correct.

The fix replaces silver_customers with a version filtered to is_current. Its columns stay the same.
